title: Where's the subway station?
summary: A visitor asks a passer-by the way to the subway.

sentences.zh: 不好意思，请问地铁站在哪儿？
sentences.en: Excuse me, where's the subway station?
The subway station isn't far from here.

sentences.zh: 有多远？我可以走路去吗？
sentences.en: How far is it? Can I walk there?

sentences.zh: 可以，走路十五分钟就到了。
sentences.en: Yes, it's fifteen minutes on foot.

sentences.zh: 你往前走，到了路口往右走。
sentences.en: Go straight ahead, and at the crossing turn right.
Turn right, and then which way?

sentences.zh: 再走五分钟，你就能看到地铁站了。它在一个商场旁边。
sentences.en: Walk five more minutes and you'll see the station. It's next to a shopping mall.

sentences.zh: 商场旁边，我记得了。太谢谢你了！
sentences.en: Next to the mall, got it. Thank you so much!

questions.prompt: How long does it take to walk to the station?
why: Right: 走路十五分钟就到了 (with the last five minutes included).
Five minutes is only the last part after turning right.

questions.prompt: Which way does he turn at the crossing?
why: He keeps going forward, then turns right.

questions.prompt: What is next to the station?
why: Right: 它在一个商场旁边.
